live.instructions: This server provides access to experiences related information and services.

tools.name: get_experience_details
tools.title: Get experience details
tools.description: Retrieves enriched information for a specific Viator experience, including detailed descriptions, highlights, imagery, pricing, duration, key features, and the click-out URL.It also returns what is included and excluded in the price, high-level itinerary metadata, bookable experience options, traveler age bands and booking constraints, start/end locations and traveler pickup, additional information such as requirements and restrictions, available language guides, associated destinations, the operating time zone, the operator, every image for the experience with its available dimension variants and captions, and the cancellation policy covering the refund terms, weather and minimum-traveler cancellation conditions, and how much is refundable depending on how far in advance the booking is cancelled.The model should call this tool only when the user clearly refers to a specific experience—either by selecting it in the UI or by asking follow-up questions such as “Tell me more about…”;if multiple experiences were shown, the model must resolve ambiguity by asking which one the user means. This tool is intended for deepening experience understanding rather than search, and should only be invoked with a code previously returned by search_experiences. get_experience_details only returns high-level itinerary metadata. Full itinerary content, including the sequence of stops and activities, detailed descriptions, and location information, is available through get_experience_itinerary. Clients should call that tool on demand when the traveler asks for more detail about what happens during the experience.

code.description: (required) Unique identifier of the Viator experience to retrieve details for.This value must correspond to an experience previously returned by the search_experiences tool.The model must not guess or make up experience IDs; if the user request is ambiguous (e.g., multiple items shown), the model must ask which experience they mean before calling the tool.

language.description: (deprecated) This value is deprecated and should not be sent. Please only send the locale.

locale.description: (optional) The language/locale code requested for content localization (e.g., en-US, en-GB, fr-FR).If not provided by the user, the model should infer it from context or default to en.Used to descriptions, highlights, and content where available.

currency.description: (optional) Currency code for from-price display (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).When provided, fromPrice and fromPriceBeforeDiscount are populated.When omitted, pricing fields are not returned.Should match the currency used in the preceding search_experiences call when available.

sessionId.description: (required) Identifier for the current user session. Re-use the value of previous MCP calls in the same conversation.

quantity.description: Number of units of the item or service, when specified.

typeDescription.description: Specific type of included or excluded item or service.

language.description: Language in which the guide or language service is provided.

type.description: Type of language service provided: human tour guide, audio or written guide.

address.description: Human-readable address of the location, when available.

additionalInfo.description: Additional instructions or operational information related to traveler pickup.

minutesBeforeDepartureTimeForPickup.description: Number of minutes before the scheduled departure time that pickup occurs, when specified.

pickupOptionType.description: Indicates how traveler pickup is handled.

travelerPickup.description: How traveler pickup is handled, when pickup is offered.

additionalInfo.description: Additional information travelers should know before booking or taking part in the experience, such as requirements, restrictions or operational details.

description.description: Human-readable details about the requirement, restriction or other information.

type.description: Category of additional information, used to distinguish different types of requirements, restrictions or operational information.

ageBands.description: Supported traveler age categories and booking constraints for the experience. These values should be used to construct the Pax Mix for subsequent availability and booking calls.

ageBand.description: Traveler category this age band applies to. Use this value when building the Pax Mix for availability and booking calls.

endAge.description: Maximum age, inclusive, for travelers in this age band.

maxTravelersPerBooking.description: Maximum number of travelers from this age band permitted in a booking, when a maximum applies.

minTravelersPerBooking.description: Minimum number of travelers from this age band permitted in a booking, when a minimum applies.

startAge.description: Minimum age, inclusive, for travelers in this age band.

cancelIfBadWeather.description: Indicates whether the experience may be cancelled due to unsuitable weather conditions.

cancelIfInsufficientTravelers.description: Indicates whether the experience may be cancelled if the minimum number of travelers is not met.

description.description: Human-readable description of the cancellation and refund terms.

refundEligibility.description: Refund rules that apply based on how far in advance the booking is cancelled.

dayRangeMax.description: Maximum number of days before the experience start date for which this refund rule applies.

dayRangeMin.description: Minimum number of days before the experience start date for which this refund rule applies.

percentageRefundable.description: Percentage of the booking price that is refundable when the cancellation falls within this time range.

type.description: Type of cancellation policy that applies to the booking.

cancellationPolicy.description: Cancellation and refund terms that apply to the booking.

destinations.description: Destinations associated with the experience based on traveler relevance. A destination may represent where the experience is typically searched for or starts from rather than the exact physical location of every activity.

name.description: Human-readable name of the destination associated with the experience.

parentDestination.description: Human-readable name of the parent destination, when available.

type.description: Type or level of destination represented by this entry, when available.

exclusions.description: Items, services, or features that are not included in the experience price.

images.description: Images for this experience, led by the one chosen as the thumbnail. The leading entry is the same picture as the thumbnail field, marked with isThumbnail.

caption.description: Natural language description of the image, suitable for display to the user. Translated into the language given by the locale parameter where a translation exists.

isThumbnail.description: Whether this image is considered the thumbnail (leading) image for this experience.

variants.description: Dimension/resolution variants available for this image.

height.description: Height of this image variant in pixels.

url.description: URL from which this image variant can be retrieved.

width.description: Width of this image variant in pixels.

inclusions.description: Items, services, or features included in the experience price.

itineraryType.description: Indicates the structure used to represent the itinerary. Determines which itinerary-specific fields are returned. For the full step-by-step itinerary, including stops, activities, and detailed location information, use get_experience_itinerary.

languageGuides.description: Guide or language services available for this experience.

logistics.description: General logistics information for the experience. Individual experience options may provide different or more specific logistics information.

maxTravelersInSharedTour.description: Maximum number of travelers that may participate when the experience operates as a shared tour.

name.description: Name of the operator providing the experience.

operator.description: Information about the operator providing the experience.

options.description: Bookable variants of the experience. Different options may have different languages, logistics, or other characteristics.

description.description: Description of what distinguishes this option from other options for the experience.

languageGuides.description: Guide or language services available for this experience option.

logistics.description: Logistics information specific to this experience option. Where present, option-level logistics should be used when evaluating or booking this option.

optionCode.description: Unique identifier for the experience option. Use this value when referencing the option in subsequent calls.

title.description: Human-readable name of the experience option.

privateTour.description: Indicates whether the experience is operated as a private tour.

skipTheLine.description: Indicates whether the experience includes skip-the-line or priority access.

timeZone.description: Time zone in which the experience operates. Used to interpret local dates and times associated with the experience.

tools.name: search_experiences
tools.title: Search for experiences
tools.description:
Retrieves a curated list of Viator experiences based on a free-text search of what the user wants (destination, activity type, and preferences), plus trip dates and optional refiners (budget, duration, etc.).
The model must supply a non-blank searchTerm as natural language describing where and what the user is looking for (e.g. "walking tours in Paris, France", "kid friendly food experiences in Rome"). Dates, prices, duration limits, and currency belong in their dedicated parameters—not inside searchTerm.
The model must provide searchTerm and dates before calling this tool. The model may re-issue a refined searchExperiences call whenever the user adds, removes, or adjusts refinement criteria (e.g., kid-friendly, price range, shorter duration) to narrow or improve the results.
If the tool returns zero results, the model must proactively guide the user toward a successful refinement. It should review the parameters used in the failed request and recommend the most appropriate based on the proposed logic:"
If > 1 categories applied, suggest removing some categories. Eg: “It looks like those categories combined are too restrictive. Would you like to narrow it down?”
If the query requests a specific feature (eg private tour), suggest removing this constraint. Eg: “Private tours may be limited in this area, would you like to consider group options too?”
If duration (avg from/to) > XX, suggest trying a shorter duration.
If duration (avg from/to) < XX, suggest trying a longer duration.
If price constraint was applied, suggest widening (or removing) price limits.
Else, suggest broaden location search. Eg: “Nothing matches in central Siena, should we try Tuscany or nearby towns?”

searchTerm.description: (required) Natural-language description of what the user is looking for. Must be non-blank and at most 500 characters; the tool rejects empty, whitespace-only, or over-length values. Include destination, activity type, and preferences in this single free-text query (e.g. 'walking tours in Paris, France'). Do not embed dates, prices, duration limits, or currency here—use the dedicated fields.

startDate.description: (required) The first date the user is available to participate in an experience, formatted as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).The model must convert natural-language expressions (e.g., 'this summer', 'next weekend', 'early April', 'tomorrow') into a specific ISO date before calling the tool. When resolving these expressions, if searchTerm names a destination, use that location's local timezone. Otherwise, use the user's current timezone. The date must not be in the past. Must be before the endDate. There is no upper bound: a date any distance in the future is searchable, so a user planning a far-off trip must still be shown what a destination offers. Booking, however, is limited to travel dates within 85 days of today - check_availability and hold_booking reject anything beyond that. So when this date is more than 85 days away, the model must present the results as research rather than as bookable, and must not present any returned price as current or hold-able.

endDate.description: (required) The last date the user is available to participate in an experience, formatted as ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DD).Also derived from natural-language expressions (e.g., 'this summer', 'next weekend', 'early April', 'tomorrow'); if the user gives a single day, set endDate = startDate. When resolving these expressions, use the destination timezone from searchTerm when inferable, otherwise the user's timezone. Must be >= startDate. Used to widen search results to a date range.

duration.description: (optional) User preference for maximum experience length, expressed in minutes.Used to filter results to experiences at or below this duration.

fromPrice.description: (optional) Minimum per-person price to include in search, expressed in the requested currency.Used when the user specifies a lower budget boundary (e.g., “at least €50”).

toPrice.description: (optional) Maximum per-person price to include in search, expressed in the requested currency.Used when the user expresses a maximum budget (e.g., “under $100”)

currency.description: (optional) Currency code used for interpreting and filtering prices.The model should infer currency from context when possible (e.g., GBP if the user is in the UK; USD if the user specifies dollars).Default value: USDValid ISO currency codes include: AED, ARS, AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CLP, CNY, COP, DKK, EUR, FJD, GBP, HKD, IDR, ILS, INR, ISK, JPY, KRW, MXN, MYR, NOK, NZD, PEN, PHP, PLN, SEK, SGD, THB, TRY, TWD, USD, VND, ZAR

limit.description: (optional) Maximum number of products to return, between 1 and 10.If omitted, defaults to 5.Not intended as a user-facing refinement mechanism; the model should not use it to alter intent.

locale.description: (optional) The language/locale code requested for content localization (e.g., en-US, en-GB, fr-FR).If not provided by the user, the model should infer it from context or default to en.Used to localize title, and other content where available.

sessionId.description: (optional) Session identifier. If provided, it will be echoed in the response, otherwise a server-generated value to reuse on follow-up calls. Repeated calls to search_experiences during the same conversation should re-use the first identifier.
